--- title: How to migrate from Pages to the App Router nav_title: App Router description: Learn how to upgrade your existing Next.js application from the Pages Router to the App Router. --- This guide will help you: - [Update your Next.js application from version 12 to version 13](#nextjs-version) - [Upgrade features that work in both the `pages` and the `app` directories](#upgrading-new-features) - [Incrementally migrate your existing application from `pages` to `app`](#migrating-from-pages-to-app) ## Upgrading ### Node.js Version The minimum Node.js version is now **v18.17**. See the [Node.js documentation](https://nodejs.org/docs/latest-v18.x/api/) for more information. ### Next.js Version To update to Next.js version 13, run the following command using your preferred package manager: ```bash package="pnpm" pnpm add next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest ``` ```bash package="npm" npm install next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest ``` ```bash package="yarn" yarn add next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest ``` ```bash package="bun" bun add next@latest react@latest react-dom@latest ``` ### ESLint Version If you're using ESLint, you need to upgrade your ESLint version: ```bash package="pnpm" pnpm add -D eslint-config-next@latest ``` ```bash package="npm" npm install -D eslint-config-next@latest ``` ```bash package="yarn" yarn add -D eslint-config-next@latest ``` ```bash package="bun" bun add -D eslint-config-next@latest ``` > **Good to know**: You may need to restart the ESLint server in VS Code for the ESLint changes to take effect. Completed the full Pages Router → App Router migration. The `pages` directory has been removed entirely, and no legacy `next/router`, `next/head`, `next/document`, or Pages data-fetching APIs remain.

Key changes:

- Replaced `_app` and `_document` with a typed [root layout](/workspace/app/layout.tsx:1), App Router metadata, `next/font`, global styles, and a typed client [AppProvider](/workspace/components/AppProvider.tsx:1).
- Migrated the SSR homepage to an async [Server Component](/workspace/app/page.tsx:1) using `await headers()` and uncached fetching.
- Migrated the blog routes with ISR, [generateStaticParams and async params](/workspace/app/blog/[id]/page.tsx:22), dynamic metadata, `notFound()`, and an App Router loading state.
- Replaced simple programmatic navigation with `Link`; retained `useRouter` from `next/navigation` only for browser-history back navigation.
- Converted API routes into typed Web API Route Handlers:
  - [Posts collection](/workspace/app/api/posts/route.ts:1)
  - [Individual post](/workspace/app/api/posts/[id]/route.ts:1)
- Replaced custom 404/error handling with [not-found.tsx](/workspace/app/not-found.tsx:1), [error.tsx](/workspace/app/error.tsx:1), and `global-error.tsx`.
- Added generated App Router `PageProps`, `LayoutProps`, and `RouteContext` typing support.

Verification passed:

- `npx next typegen`
- `npx tsc --noEmit`
- `npm run build`
- Production smoke tests for all pages and API methods
- Confirmed `/blog` revalidates every 60 seconds and generated post pages every 300 seconds
- Confirmed on-demand dynamic post rendering and automatic `405 Method Not Allowed`
- Confirmed no Pages Router directory or legacy APIs remain
